verified_context: User requests contextual primary and secondary Then groups under suitable components. Primary controls stay visible; secondary actions use an overflow dropdown. Existing canonical forms, permissions and confirmation must remain authoritative.

Compiler already lowers canonical form operations without row scope; edit/delete/action row operations retain their existing row checks. Cards and generated row views already have the pending action-group layout implementation. Page renderer already owns a heading and an evaluated array of child HTML. Dialog/drawer have named slots; collection rows differ between table/list.

Adding page host plus canonical form child would use existing form preparation with a compact dialog opener, allow page Create actions, and require page-heading partition/layout tests. Restricting to card/view avoids that work but cannot express a page Create action. Dialog/collection support would need additional placement contracts.

host_set.instructions: Which initial host set best completes the user-requested primary/secondary action priorities with clear ownership and proportionate implementation?

criteria.A: Support card and row-bound view only, with edit/delete/action children. Explicitly reject other hosts and document future possibilities.
criteria.B: Support page, card and row-bound view with canonical form/edit/delete/action children. Each child retains its owning scope rules; existing form preparation supports row-free Create. Define shared heading placement and postpone other hosts.
criteria.C: Support page, card, view, dialog/drawer and collection row hosts now, defining each placement and preserving canonical scope rules. More complete vocabulary with more integration work.
